content.title: Alec Baldwin to retire from acting: ‘I don’t want to leave my house’
content.text: The actor has spoken publicly about his trauma after a 2021 shooting on the set of the western film Rust that killed the cinematographer Halyna Hutchins Alec Baldwin said he wanted only to “retire and stay at home with my kids”Dimitrios Kambouris/Getty Images Tuesday April 14 2026, 4.50pm BST, The Times Alec Baldwin has said he wants to retire from acting because of his trauma linked to the on-set shooting of a cinematographer. The Oscar-nominated actor, 68, was charged with involuntary manslaughter after he was holding a gun that discharged and killed Halyna Hutchins on the set of the western film Rust in October 2021. The case against Baldwin collapsed midway through the trial in New Mexico in July 2024, when a judge ruled that prosecutors had acted improperly. Baldwin, who has only worked sparingly and on smaller projects since the shooting, has said the case almost destroyed his physical and mental health. “I wound up staying home a lot,” he told The Hollywood Reporter. “I was home with my kids for three and a half years — I hardly worked at all … I don’t want to leave my house any more. I don’t. I don’t want to work any more. I don’t. I really don’t. I want to retire and stay home with my kids.” Halyna Hutchins died after the shooting on a film set in New Mexicoinstagram Baldwin, who has seven children with his wife Hilaria Baldwin, as well as an adult daughter with the actress Kim Basinger, had to finish filming Rust as part of a wrongful-death lawsuit settlement with Hutchins’s widower. Alec Baldwin: I won’t watch Rust. My wife is traumatised The film was released a year ago but flopped at the box office, a disappointment analysts put down to the film’s notoriety. Baldwin said finishing Rust was bad for his health. “It impacted me in every way — financially, career-wise, my wife, my kids, my health. I was so sick,” he said. “I mean, we had to finish. We gave him the movie and said, ‘You sell it and do whatever you want with it.’ So I had to go [finish the film], and I was really sick — I had a nerve condition that you get when you take blood-pressure medication, orthostatic hypotension, where you black out.” Alec and Hilaria Baldwin starred in an ill-fated reality-TV show about their family lifeWarner Bros Baldwin said he once blacked out and fell on his wife. “It was horrible,” he added. Alec Baldwin’s wife Hilaria: Mockery of my accent put me in a dark place After Hutchins’s death Baldwin, one of the most acclaimed stars of his generation, said he lost work in Hollywood and has barely been booked for jobs. Amid reports of money troubles related to paying huge legal fees to defend himself in court, Baldwin and his family appeared in a reality-television series last year. The Baldwins was critically panned and a second season is unlikely.
